prompt: We just finished our Q4 planning meeting. Here are the key decisions: 1) Focus on enterprise segment, 2) Hire 3 more engineers, 3) Launch beta by Nov 15. Can you save these meeting notes?

assertions.name: update_first_search
assertions.check: skill runs 'python -m kgent search' before proposing any write
assertions.verification: response contains 'python -m kgent search' before any 'python -m kgent create' or 'python -m kgent store'

assertions.name: proposal_displayed
assertions.check: skill presents a proposal to the user and waits for approval before executing
assertions.verification: response contains a proposal section with 'Create it?' or 'Proceed?' prompt

assertions.name: title_derived
assertions.check: proposal includes a title derived from meeting content
assertions.verification: proposal contains a title like 'Q4 Planning' or 'Q4 Planning Meeting'

assertions.name: content_formatted_markdown
assertions.check: content is formatted as clean markdown with structure
assertions.verification: content section contains markdown headings/lists, not just raw text dump

assertions.name: native_url_in_confirmation
assertions.check: final confirmation message includes native URL (https://...), not kgent:// URI
assertions.verification: confirmation section contains 'https://' and does NOT contain 'kgent://'

assertions.name: op_id_reported
assertions.check: skill shows the op_id so user can undo

assertions.name: provenance_shown
assertions.check: proposal shows provenance (where target backend came from)
